commits.message: Cut the end slot only at its edges, so a glyph outside the BMP stays whole; pin Syriac Prepend and the drawn-cursor slot (review of #569)
The end slot past the text never joins a Prepend character's cluster, so under visual order the caret after U+0600-U+0605 keeps its cell (rich-control-codes-xh4n.q87)

The caret past a mixed-direction text stands beside the last character typed: CaretMark.after marks the blank a widget adds past the text, and ordering gives it the level before it (rich-control-codes-xh4n.tmh) (#568)

* The caret past a mixed-direction text stands beside the last character typed: CaretMark.after marks the blank a widget adds past the text, and ordering gives it the level before it (rich-control-codes-xh4n.tmh)

* The end slot is a fact of its own: Style.textEnd marks the blank past the text on every path — probe, fallback, drawn caret, terminal caret, Dropdown — and ordering folds it into clusterLevels' 'level before it' rule; a press past a row lands on Stops.end (rich-control-codes-xh4n.tmh)

* Drop _endCells and Stops.end: a wrapped row's end stays a probe, so no layout shifts and a press past a row still lands on the end; keep a caret segment's control at the end slot; delete the uncalled shownOrder; scope the docs to the orders the frame orders; narrow the step oracle's skip to an unpressable line end (rich-control-codes-xh4n.tmh)

* The end past the text is drawn only under the caret, a probe otherwise, so no row shows a blank its value lacks; the probe is found by index now that padding follows it; a press on a single-line bracket is one on the cell inside it; the claude-sessions search bar marks its end cell; Style.textEnd has its own tests (rich-control-codes-xh4n.tmh)
